mapper.insert: INSERT INTO idempotency_requests (user_id, operation_code, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, status, expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{operationCode}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestFingerprint}, 'PROCESSING', #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, operation_code, request_fingerprint, status, response_http_status, response_body, expires_at FROM idempotency_requests WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND operation_code = #{operationCode} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE idempotency_requests SET status = 'COMPLETED', response_http_status = #{responseHttpStatus}, response_body = #{responseBody}, completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE id = #{claimId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
